verdict.rationale: Firecrawl's docs say that after scraping a page you can keep working with it: click, fill forms, extract dynamic content, or navigate deeper. Managed Browser Sandbox sessions back this up for interactive workflows, so the core capability is directly claimed. The evidence never shows these interactions being used to log in, so reaching content behind a login wall is only implied, and the support rests on short marketing-level doc lines. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of authenticating through login forms and persisting session cookies, detailed API docs for the click and form actions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can keep interacting with an already-scraped page, clicking and filling forms to reach content behind a login wall
